summary: Iteration 7 targeted regression on the 8 fixes to iteration-6 findings. Backend: 98/98 pytest tests pass (31 new iteration-7 tests + 67 prior regression tests) on the public URL. FIX 1 verified: POST /api/availability now rejects malformed times ('99:99', 'aa:bb', '9:0', '25:00'), start>=end and durations 4/0/-10/241/999 with 400, and the computed doctor_id is persisted correctly (doctor caller -> own id, admin caller -> body.doctor_id, invalid/absent doctor -> 400, patient -> 403); the stored row shows up on GET /api/availability/{id} and generates real slots (Sunday 18:00-20:00 @20min). FIX 2 verified: PUT groups periods by weekday - two same-weekday entries that overlap (09:00-12:00 + 10:00-13:00) and a contained period (09:00-17:00 + 10:00-11:00) both return 400 'Periods on the same day cannot overlap', while adjacent (09:00-12:00 + 12:00-15:00) and disjoint (09:00-11:00 + 14:00-16:00) same-weekday entries store correctly, and in-entry overlaps still 400. FIX 6 verified: GET /api/patient-documents/{id}/file owner 200 byte-exact, other patient 404, doctor 403, admin 200, unauthenticated 401, unknown id 404. FIX 7 data path verified: block -> status needs_rescheduling + patient notification + blocked date returns no slots + DELETE restores the slot. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): FIX 3 nav highlight correct on every client-side navigation (exactly one .active link, matching the route, for all 4 doctor nav items); FIX 4 overlap save renders data-testid=schedule-message with class 'schedule-alert error' (bg rgb(255,240,239), text 'Periods on the same day cannot overlap') while a successful save renders plain 'schedule-alert'; FIX 5 admin schedule-doctor-select never unmounts across 3 doctor switches (polled every 40ms) and keeps its value; FIX 6 view-document-{id} buttons render for every submission, href points at /api/patient-documents/{id}/file and returns 200 application/pdf (also verified end-to-end on a freshly uploaded document, byte-exact); FIX 7 rebook-{id} link present on the single needs_rescheduling row, absent on all 10 other rows, and navigates to /app/doctors; FIX 8 empty title/file yields 'schedule-alert error' red box on /app/uploads. Responsive: /app/schedule grid 1 track @375px (345px) and @390px (358.8px), 3 tracks @1280px, zero horizontal overflow; /app/uploads .admin-report-grid 1 track @375/390, 2 tracks @1280, zero overflow.

minor.issue: duration is still taken from the first rule of the day only (day_rules[0]['duration']), so a legacy POST that writes a different duration for a second period on the same weekday is silently reported with the first period's duration. Slot generation does honour per-rule duration, so GET and /slots can disagree.

Still has no overlap check against existing rules for the same weekday, so the legacy endpoint can create overlapping periods that PUT would reject (400). Duplicate slot labels are de-duplicated in /slots so impact is cosmetic, but validation is inconsistent between the two write paths.
Unchanged from iteration 6: delete_many + N inserts with no transaction/bulk_write; a mid-write failure leaves a partial schedule.

issues: 19 leftover TEST_/UITEST submissions make the 'Review status' column extremely long with no pagination, filter or scroll container; consider capping/pagination (also no delete endpoint exists so accumulated rows cannot be removed).
Cards still have unequal heights so the auto-fill grid looks staggered (Saturday/Sunday short cards leave gaps); align-items:start is applied but a consistent min-height would tidy it.

action_items: Optional hardening only: make GET /api/availability represent per-period durations (or forbid mixed durations per weekday), and apply the same overlap check to the legacy POST /api/availability so both write paths agree.
Optional: cap/paginate the patient 'Review status' list on /app/uploads and provide a way to remove test/obsolete submissions.
critical_code_review_comments: All 8 reported fixes are correctly implemented in /app/backend/server.py (lines 106-152) and /app/frontend/src/App.js (Shell useLocation, Schedule msg={text,error} + always-mounted picker, Uploads view link, Appointment rebook link).

Two legacy pytest tests (test_iteration2_focus.py::test_concurrent_same_slot_is_single_success and test_iteration3_reminders.py) were non-idempotent: they book fixed 09:00/10:00 slots on the next Monday and never released them, so re-runs failed with 409 on stale confirmed appointments. Added cleanup cancels (test-code fix only) and cancelled the two stale appointments apt_308db58053 / apt_ef3538bf9d.
App.js is still a single dense 144-line file with very long lines; splitting Schedule/Uploads into modules remains advisable for maintainability.
Emergent dev-overlay injects <span> inside <option> causing a React hydration warning in console on /app/schedule; not app code, no functional impact.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 UI fixes + responsive checks passed

rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found this iteration. The only failures in the first full run were environmental: earlier iterations left confirmed appointments at 09:00 and 10:00 on 2026-08-31 for demo_doctor_1, which the fixed-slot legacy tests re-book, producing 409. Root cause = non-idempotent test code, not application behaviour; fixed by cancelling the stale rows and adding cleanup to those two tests. All 98 tests then passed twice in a row.
